settings.heading: Swaps Done Properly for Footscray Cars
settings.body1: Planning an engine conversion in Footscray? Niche Automotive handles complete swaps end to end at our Sunshine West workshop, from the mounts and wiring through to cooling, fuelling and the tune.
settings.body2: Footscray is just across the Maribyrnong River from the workshop, an easy run out along Ballarat Road. Bring the car in, tell us the engine you want in it and what you want the car to do, and we will map out the swap with you before any work starts.
settings.points: Complete engine swaps | Mounts, wiring & plumbing | Cooling & fuelling sorted | Tuned to suit the combination
settings.highlights_lead: A conversion is more than dropping a different motor in. Here is how we make sure the swap still works as a whole car when it is finished.
settings.seo_description: Engine conversions and swaps for Footscray drivers. Mounts, wiring, cooling, fuelling and tuning handled end to end at Niche Automotive in Sunshine West.
settings.strip_sub: Tell us the car and the engine you want in it, and we'll map out the swap.

settings.question: Do you do engine conversions for Footscray cars?
settings.answer: Yes. Footscray is about a 12 minute drive from our Sunshine West workshop. Bring the car in with the engine you have in mind and we will talk through what the swap involves.

settings.question: What does an engine conversion at Niche include?
settings.answer: The whole swap, handled in-house: engine mounts, wiring, plumbing, cooling, fuelling and the tune for the new combination. Doing it all in one workshop means every part of the job is set up to work with the rest.

settings.question: Do you do LS swaps?
settings.answer: Yes. LS swaps are among the conversions that come through the workshop, along with engine swaps across all makes and models. The approach is the same whatever goes in: mounts, wiring, cooling and fuel sorted properly, then tuned to suit.

settings.question: Why does the wiring matter so much in a swap?
settings.answer: Because a conversion is only as good as the wiring behind it. The loom, mounts, cooling, fuel, exhaust and tune all have to work together, or you end up with a car that runs but is never quite right. That is the part of the job we take the most care over.

settings.question: Should I swap the engine or rebuild the one I have?
settings.answer: It depends on the car, the condition of the engine it has now and what you want the car to do. We do both, engine conversions and engine builds and rebuilds, so we can give you a straight answer on which makes more sense rather than steering you toward one.

settings.question: How much does an engine conversion cost?
settings.answer: It depends on the car, the engine going in and what you want out of it, so there is no honest flat price. Tell us the car and the engine you want in it, and we will map out the swap and talk you through it before any work starts.

settings.question: Do you work on all makes and models?
settings.answer: Yes. We work on all makes and models, and as Holden and Commodore specialists we know those cars inside out.

settings.question: Where are you and when are you open?
settings.answer: The workshop is at 4/94 Boundary Road, Sunshine West VIC 3020, open Monday to Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm and Saturday 8:00am to 12:00pm. Give us a call on 0411 019 935 to talk through a conversion.

settings.intro: Common questions about engine conversions and swaps at Niche Automotive. Can't find your answer? Give the workshop a call on 0411 019 935.
settings.foot_sub: We're happy to help. Give the workshop a call or send an enquiry and we'll get back to you.
